answer: A signed marketplace.revocation-list/v1 is signature-verified before every install. Revoked keys and withdrawn versions are REFUSED and place zero files (filesystem census). A non-revoked package installs in the same run. When the list is unreachable after 3 fetch attempts, a durable STALE warning is written to the degrade-loudly sink and known-revoked entries in the cache stay refused. Unsigned, wrong-key, and lower-sequence lists cannot un-revoke. Publishing is an owner action (Ed25519 verify-only; no key generation). SUCCESS:IMP-0079

evidence.claim: A revoked package version and a revoked publisher key are refused at install, placing zero payload files; a non-revoked package installs in the same run (negative control).

evidence.claim: With the list unreachable, STALE is surfaced through the durable degrade-loudly sink (readable from a later sink object) and anything already known-revoked in the cached list is hard-refused. An attacker who blocks the network, or who presents an unsigned / untrusted / lower-sequence empty list, cannot silently un-revoke.

negative_controls.description: A non-revoked package must install in the same run as revoked refusals, so a broken installer cannot be mistaken for working revocation.
Unreachable list must emit STALE on a durable sink readable from a new DegradeSink on the same path. In-process return values alone are not the degrade-loudly channel.
negative_controls.good_state_output: fresh signed list: list_state FRESH, no STALE required

owner_gate.enforced: unsigned and non-owner signatures are ListSignatureError
owner_gate.note: This unit implements the owner gate; it does not mint or rotate keys.

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0077 (package digest signature format) and IMP-0078 (trust policy) are catalog dependencies and are not delivered on this worktree. This unit verifies the revocation LIST with owner Ed25519; it does not claim to verify package-artifact signatures.
IMP-0054 (estate-wide degrade-loudly channel) is not delivered. tools/marketplace/revocation_list/degrade.py is the install-time sink this unit uses; it is bounded (256 records) and durable.

retry.policy: bounded backoff x3 on fetch failure, then unreachable-list policy
